# MyGo editor

This local module contains the MIT-licensed editor from MyGo v0.10.0.
Nemorous adds whitespace policies, Diff gutter controls, and a three-way
comparison. Its Markdown view uses the same editor for code blocks.
The Markdown parser and the rest of MyGo come from the upstream module.

Source [MyGo v0.10.0](https://github.com/egoist/mygo/tree/v0.10.0)
